svg.title: FastVCL: sparse-to-tube video copy localization framework
svg.desc: Proposed sparse-to-tube method with two budgeted insertions of one shared selective visual-decision model named seltive model: anchor filtering before RANSAC (A0 to A1) and fragment fusion after candidate extraction (C0 to Y). Both call sites share one pair budget, cache and model revision, and abstain on uncertainty or failure; unselected, uncertain and failed items keep their core evidence. Matrices and trajectories are schematic, not empirical outputs.
svg.text: Distinct-time support on A and B
Local DP with a zero restart
ONE SHARED MODEL · TWO CALL SITES
one budget K · cache · one revision
A/B original frames + verified index → frame map
Core + two budgeted visual decisions · feature-index coordinates
